relationships.subject: history of depression
relationships.evidence_quote: Fatigued survivors with a history of depression (n = 214) had significantly higher physical, emotional and cognitive fatigue and showed significantly less amelioration of fatigue from FU1 to FU2 than survivors without depression.

key_findings: Cluster analysis delineated a fatigue subtype (CL1) with high TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, resistin, VEGF-A and GM-CSF, high BMI and pain, and a leptin-high subtype with cognitive fatigue.
Fatigued survivors with a history of depression had higher fatigue and less improvement over time.
